EN:
So it's time I greet everyone a new
way.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:000A:}}Yeah, I'm tired of the same
old "{{TAG:0007:0006:}}hey, hello{{TAG:0007:0007:}}."
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}How about you give me a new
go-to greeting, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
I've got one!
Sorry, no.
ES:
Bueno, ya va siendo hora de ir
saludando a la gente de otra forma.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Lo de "¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Eh, hola{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!"
está demodé.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¿Tienes alguna sugerencia,
mi estimad{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
¡Sí!
Lo siento
FR:
Bon, ma sempiternelle salutation
« {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Hé{{TAG:0007:0007:}} ! » a fait
son temps...
J'ai créé un concours pour que les
gens puissent m'en proposer une
nouvelle. Ça te dit, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
Chouette !
Débrouille-toi tout seul.
IT:
Basta, è ora che la smetta di
salutare tutti con il solito
"{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Ehi, hola{{TAG:0007:0007:}}".
Perché non mi consigli un saluto
supertosto che mi faccia fare
bella figura con todos, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
Ma certo!
Sono a corto di idee...
DE:
Es wird Zeit, dass ich mir eine
originellere Begrüßung als
„{{TAG:0007:0006:}}hey, hallo{{TAG:0007:0007:}}“ zulege.
Wie wär's, wenn du dir eine neue
Begrüßung für mich ausdenkst,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
Ich hab eine!
Nee, lass mal.
TRANSLATION:
Demek artık herkesi yeni bir şekilde
selamlamamın vakti geldi.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:000A:}}Evet, eski
"{{TAG:0007:0006:}}hey, selam{{TAG:0007:0007:}}"dan sıkıldım.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bana kullanıp durabileceğim yeni
bir selam versene, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
Buldum!
Üzgünüm, yok.

EN:
So I really need to spice up my
greeting, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Yeah, {{TAG:0003:0028:}}no more
"{{TAG:0007:0006:}}hey, hi there{{TAG:0007:0007:}}" for me.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}How about you give me a new one?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Please? {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Something just for me?{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
I've got one!
Sorry, no.
ES:
Mi saludo se está volviendo un poco
normalucho, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Necesito
uno más vanguardista.
El viejo "¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Hola, buenas{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!"
no es lo bastante transgresor.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Qué tal si me ayudas?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
¡Claro!
Lo siento
FR:
Une nana a osé me dire que ma
salutation était has-been.
T'imagines la tragédie, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?
Franchement, entre nous,
« {{TAG:0007:0006:}}Hé{{TAG:0007:0007:}} ! »...
dépassé ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Mais bon, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}par prudence,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} il vaut
peut-être mieux que je change.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
T'aurais pas une idée, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
Si.
Non.
IT:
Ho proprio bisogno di vivacizzare
il mio saluto, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Ho chiuso
con "{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Ehi, ehilà, hola{{TAG:0007:0007:}}".
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Me ne potresti consigliare uno?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Dai, por favor! {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Qualcosa di speciale
che sia perfetto per me?{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
Ma certo!
Sono a corto di idee...
TRANSLATION:
Selamımı gerçekten biraz renklendirmem
lazım, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Evet, {{TAG:0003:0028:}}artık "{{TAG:0007:0006:}}hey,
selamlar{{TAG:0007:0007:}}" yok.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Bana yeni bir tane verir misin?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Lütfen? {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Sadece bana özel olsun?{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0008:0005:0400150003002800}}
Buldum!
Üzgünüm, yok.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}What? You're OK with my usual
hello, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I'll hang on to it
a little longer then.
ES:
Entonces, ¿crees que debo seguir
con mi saludo habitual, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Claro, los clásicos no pasan nunca
de moda.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ah, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}je vois,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} bonjour la solidarité,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}} ! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tant pis, je vais garder

IT:
Non mi dire che ti piace quello che
uso sempre, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Beh, allora
continuerò a usarlo per un po'...
DE:

Begrüßung, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dann werde
ich sie wohl erst mal beibehalten.

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ne? Her zamanki selamım sana uyuyor

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I knew I could count on you to help

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Lo sapevo che potevo contare
su di te, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich wusste, dass ich auf dich zählen

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Havalı kalmama yardım etmek için sana

DE:
Also doch nicht? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Na gut, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}vielleicht

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
